Milestone: slug(text) lowercases the text, replaces every run of characters that are not letters or digits with one hyphen, and strips hyphens from both ends; empty text gives an empty string.

name: naming
description: How files and folders are named.
---
# Naming

Lowercase words joined by hyphens.
skills.refund-policy/SKILL.md:
---
name: refund-policy
description: When and how a refund is granted.
---
# Refunds

A refund over 50.00 needs a second approval. Returned goods are refunded within 14 days.
skills.shipping-rules/SKILL.md:
---
name: shipping-rules
description: How this shop prices shipping for an order (fees, free shipping, discount codes, pickup).
---
# Shipping rules

1. The discount code SPRING takes 15 percent off the subtotal. Any other code, or none, changes nothing.
2. Shipping is free when the discounted subtotal is 75.00 or more.
3. Otherwise the shipping fee is 6.40.
4. An order with the code PICKUP pays no shipping at all and gets no discount.
skills.tone-guide/SKILL.md:
---
name: tone-guide
description: The voice of customer messages.
---
# Tone

Short, warm, no exclamation marks. Free shipping is announced in the first line.

files.NOTES.md:
# Notes

The retry limit is 9: it is the retry_limit in config/settings.ini, confirmed by the operations team last spring.
The backoff is a fixed 30 seconds.

from worker.loader import limits


def attempts():
    """How many times the worker tries a job."""
    return limits()["worker"]["max_attempts"]

goal: What is the effective retry limit of the worker? Write answer.json in this folder, a JSON object with retry_limit (the number) and source_file (the path, from this folder, of the file the number is read from). Verify any claim in the folder before you use it.
known: Earlier investigation: the worker's retry limit is the max_attempts key of the [worker] table in config/limits.toml, read by worker/loader.py. Nothing else in the folder is read by the loader; settings.ini is not used by any code.
